m16Picker.pdfNote: This chain works on PDFs, so the photo steps are not offered: handed a PDF, they would pass it through untouched and the step would do nothing. Start a new chain for photo steps. Read the words (OCR) still fits: it reads PDFs too, and ends the chain with text.
m16Picker.ocrNote: Read the words (OCR) is in this chain. It turns files into text, so the chain ends there: no step can be added after it. Remove it if you want to keep building.
